out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed paper towels were not provided at the handwashing sink at the back of the house.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CDI: PIC PROVIDED PAPER TOWELS.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed hand soap was not provided at handwashing sink at the back of the house.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. CDI: PIC PROVIDED HAND SOAP.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the back of the house being used to store lighters, buckets, and wiping cloths.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: ALL ITEMS WERE REMOVED FROM THE HAND SINK.

out_items.name: Proper cooling time and temperature

violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: pico de gallo (46 F) in the walk in cooler and pico de gallo (44 F) in the prep unit/cooler (3). The pico de gallo was prepared five hours prior and was in both units for more than four hours.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna). CDI: PICO DE GALLO WAS DISCARDED. EHS RE-EDUCATED.

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked corn (125 F) in the HH upright unit (4).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: THE CORN WAS REHEATED ON THE STOVE TO 165 F. PIC INCREASED THE TEMPERATURE OF THE HH UNIT TO 160.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked chicken (46 F), cooked beef (52-54 F), shredded mozzarella cheese (50 F), shredded cheddar cheese (51 F), and cooked veggies (52 F) in the 2-drawer cooler unit (2). All foods were in the unit for more than 4 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: ALL FOODS WERE DISCARDED.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CDI: CHEMICAL SPRAY BOTTLES WERE LABELED DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: containers of pico de gallo (46 F) packed in a plastic container with a lid stacked on top of each other in the walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. PICO DE GALLO WAS DISCARDED. ENSURE FOODS ARE PROPERLY COOLED DOWN WITHIN 4 HOURS. EHS RE-EDUCATED.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed crates of food in the walk in cooler and boxed oil and rice at the back of the house stored on the floor.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. Ensure all foods are off the floor by the next routine inspection.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 2-drawer cooler unit (4) at 46 F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW SHELL EGGS STORED ABOVE BEVERAGES AND VEGETABLES IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REORGANIZED FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. PLEASE ENSURE FOODS ARE COOLED FROM 135F TO 70F IN 2 HOURS AND TO A FURTHER 41F WITHIN A TOTAL OF 6 HOURS USING THE APPROPRIATE COOLING METHODS.
